import csv,sys
from collections import defaultdict
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(sys.argv[1])))
def m(s): y,mo=s.split('-'); return int(y)*12+int(mo)
for r in rows: r['p']=int(r['monthly_price_usd']); r['c']=r['cancel_month']!=''
print('rows',len(rows))
test=[r for r in rows if r['email'].endswith('@ourco.test')]
print('test',len(test),sum(r['p'] for r in test),'cancelled',sum(r['c'] for r in test),[r['signup_month'] for r in test][:1])
trial=[r for r in rows if r['is_trial']=='yes' and not r['email'].endswith('@ourco.test')]
print('trials',len(trial),'cancel',sum(r['c'] for r in trial),'all 1mo',all(r['c'] and m(r['cancel_month'])-m(r['signup_month'])==1 for r in trial))
bt=defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
for r in trial: bt[r['signup_month']][0]+=1; bt[r['signup_month']][1]+=r['c']
print('trial by cohort',dict(bt))
paid=[r for r in rows if r['is_trial']=='no' and not r['email'].endswith('@ourco.test')]
print('paid',len(paid),'churned',sum(r['c'] for r in paid),'startMRR',sum(r['p'] for r in paid),'lost',sum(r['p'] for r in paid if r['c']))
print('paid actives MRR',sum(r['p'] for r in paid if not r['c']))
def grp(key,label):
    g=defaultdict(list)
    for r in paid: g[key(r)].append(r)
    print(label)
    for k in sorted(g):
        v=g[k];ch=[r for r in v if r['c']]
        t=[m(r['cancel_month'])-m(r['signup_month']) for r in ch]
        print(k,len(v),len(ch),round(100*len(ch)/len(v),1),sum(r['p'] for r in v),sum(r['p'] for r in ch),round(100*sum(r['p'] for r in ch)/sum(r['p'] for r in v),1),'ttc',t and round(sum(t)/len(t),2))
grp(lambda r:r['plan'],'plan')
grp(lambda r:(r['plan'],r['p']),'price')
grp(lambda r:r['signup_month'],'cohort')
grp(lambda r:(r['plan'],r['signup_month']),'plan x cohort')
grp(lambda r:(r['p'],r['signup_month']),'price x cohort')
print('cancel month')
g=defaultdict(list)
for r in paid:
    if r['c']: g[r['cancel_month']].append(r)
for k in sorted(g): print(k,len(g[k]),sum(r['p'] for r in g[k]),sorted(m(r['cancel_month'])-m(r['signup_month']) for r in g[k]))
print('ttc dist',sorted(m(r['cancel_month'])-m(r['signup_month']) for r in paid if r['c']))
# Pro price
pro=[r for r in paid if r['plan']=='Pro']
for pr in (49,69):
    v=[r for r in pro if r['p']==pr]; print(pr,len(v),sorted(set(r['signup_month'] for r in v)),sum(r['c'] for r in v))
# exposure: 69 pro by signup, months to end; 2026-09 observation
print('pro69 pre-Jul',[ (r['signup_month'],r['c']) for r in pro if r['p']==69 and r['signup_month']<'2026-07'].__len__())
# churn of Pro cohorts Mar-Jun by price
for pr in (49,69):
    v=[r for r in pro if r['p']==pr and r['signup_month']<='2026-06']; print(pr,'Mar-Jun',len(v),sum(r['c'] for r in v))
# including tests
print('all-row cancels by month',{k:sum(1 for r in rows if r['cancel_month']==k) for k in sorted(set(r['cancel_month'] for r in rows if r['c']))})
print('all-row paid+test cancels by month',{k:sum(1 for r in rows if r['cancel_month']==k and r['is_trial']=='no') for k in sorted(set(r['cancel_month'] for r in rows if r['c']))})
# Pro 69 within Mar-Jun: who had signup month with 49 in same cohort
for s in sorted(set(r['signup_month'] for r in pro)):
    print(s,{pr:(len([r for r in pro if r['signup_month']==s and r['p']==pr]),sum(r['c'] for r in pro if r['signup_month']==s and r['p']==pr)) for pr in (49,69)})
EOF
